IMG_2285.HEIC.title: Beach: resort and restaurant frontage
IMG_2285.HEIC.observation: View from the pebble-strewn beach toward the white resort and beach restaurant frontage, with palms and seaward terraces. Useful for broad building silhouettes and the sand/stone mix; no restaurant footprint or beach elevation is measured here.

IMG_2286.HEIC.title: Elena junction: side-by-side ramp and steps
IMG_2286.HEIC.observation: Close view of a terracotta approach with a smooth sloping strip beside a flight of shallow steps, low white edging, and a transverse drain at the foot. Clipped hedge, blue flowers and a partially visible Elena plaque identify the junction. The separate steps are visible evidence not yet matched to detailed game geometry.

IMG_2287.HEIC.title: Elena junction: private doorway and planting
IMG_2287.HEIC.observation: A private brown timber door sits above small tiled entrance steps behind a low white planting wall. Blue flowers and bougainvillea screen white plaster fronts; a tall black lantern and flush utility cover are visible. Private door steps are distinct from the shared junction ramp.

IMG_2288.HEIC.title: Cervantes area: passage signed Calle Miguel
IMG_2288.HEIC.observation: Inside a covered walk-through with a visible CALLE MIGUEL plaque. Red square tiles with small decorative inserts, black hanging lanterns, barred windows, potted plants and an arch opening onto a narrow planted lane are visible. The plaque is observed; association with the full mapped Miguel de Cervantes name needs review.

IMG_2289.HEIC.title: Cervantes exit: white-edged tiled approach
IMG_2289.HEIC.observation: Looking toward the roadside hedge over a terracotta approach bounded by low white walls and planting. A drain crosses the lower end and a black lantern stands at the corner. The shape and planting support the entrance reference; the image alone does not measure its rise.

IMG_2290.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: grass between bays and shared footpath
IMG_2290.HEIC.observation: A parked car and white bay markings sit beside a grass strip with broad-leaved planting. A separate terracotta house-side footpath and white plaster frontages are behind the grass. Confirms the surface order; widths remain estimated.

IMG_2291.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: arched entrance and white facade
IMG_2291.HEIC.observation: Frontal view of a two-storey white building with an arched ground-level opening, rounded plaster balcony edge, timber shutters, barred window and lantern. The terracotta house-side footpath runs between the facade and a narrow lawn/parking edge.

IMG_2292.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: continuous tiled footpath and lawns
IMG_2292.HEIC.observation: Oblique view along white two-storey frontages, the shared terracotta path, narrow grass strip and asphalt bays. Arched openings, black window grilles, small balconies and planting divide the frontage. Useful for proportions and surface continuity.

IMG_2293.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: lane entrance, ramp and drain
IMG_2293.HEIC.observation: A terracotta entrance slopes from the parking area into a narrow lane between white patio walls and dense planting. A green drain/service grate is at the foot and a tall traditional black lantern stands at the corner. Lane name is not visible; do not assume this is Cervantes.

IMG_2294.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: flagstone approach to arch
IMG_2294.HEIC.observation: Pale irregular flagstone paving leads through an arched covered passage. Flared low white curbs, clipped hedges, blue flowers and climbing plants frame the approach. Stone paving is distinct from the square-tiled entrances elsewhere.

IMG_2295.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: covered access and shutters
IMG_2295.HEIC.observation: Second view of the flagstone approach and arched passage, showing the tiled canopy, dark louvred shutters, side balcony and planting. Corroborates IMG_2294; it is not independent measurement of the passage dimensions.

IMG_2296.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: parking turn and coast boundary
IMG_2296.HEIC.observation: View around the widened asphalt end area toward a low white wall and metal fence by the sea. Yellow curb paint, white bay lines, red-and-white post, a no-parking sign, palms and flowering planting identify the coastal turn.

IMG_2297.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: narrow pedestrian gate
IMG_2297.HEIC.observation: A narrow dark metal pedestrian gate sits beside a white pier, rigid metal mesh on a low white plinth to the left, and a taller solid white wall to the right. A modern slim lamp, yellow curb paint and a no-parking sign identify the asphalt parking end. The wall/mesh/gate arrangement is now represented in the structural model; plan position, gate width and wall heights remain estimates.
IMG_2297.HEIC.visualReview: Compared with structural wall/mesh/gate model; arrangement represented, plan position and dimensions remain estimates

IMG_2298.HEIC.title: Beach: white seaward houses and palm
IMG_2298.HEIC.observation: Beach-level view back toward two-storey white homes, dark shutters, a palm and the low coast boundary. Sand and scattered pebbles fill the foreground. This camera position is shared with the next two differently directed views.

IMG_2299.HEIC.title: Beach: houses along the shore
IMG_2299.HEIC.observation: Oblique beach view along the row of white seaward houses and palms, with a pebbled sandy foreground and distant coastline. Useful for the coastline-side silhouette and texture; individual house positions are not determined from this view.

IMG_2300.HEIC.title: Beach: pebbles, sand and distant coastline
IMG_2300.HEIC.observation: Wide view along the beach with mixed sand, stones and rounded pebbles, the sea to the right and low buildings beyond. Provides a stronger ground-material reference than a uniform pale-sand texture.

IMG_2360.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-north-east along Cervantes
IMG_2360.HEIC.observation: From a roof terrace beside Calle Elena, looking roughly along the line of Cervantes. Below: courtyard walls with magenta bougainvillea, a patio with a timber pergola, arched first-floor windows, a wooden balcony under a small barrel-tile roof and iron balconies. Beyond: flat roofs with solar panels, the long apartment block, a tall palm and the sea at the right. Camera on a roof, so the pin sits inside a registry building.

IMG_2361.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down into a gated tiled entry
IMG_2361.HEIC.observation: Looking south-west down over barrel roof tiles into a narrow entry between two-storey houses: patterned terracotta floor tiles, a pair of black iron gates in a white gateway topped with bougainvillea, a small first-floor balcony and an arched opening with lantern beyond. Gives the width and enclosure of the entry from above; dimensions are not measured. Camera on the roof of the covered-passage building (registry part 6265201UF1366N_part5).

IMG_2362.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-south-east over the terraces to the sea
IMG_2362.HEIC.observation: Over lichen-mottled barrel roof tiles and a tall magnolia-like hedge: a wooden balcony with a tiled canopy, iron balconies with arched shuttered doors, flat roofs with solar panels and chimneys, a Norfolk pine, palms, and the sea on the horizon. Good for roofscape and facade detail.

IMG_2363.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down the lane to the north pool lawn gate
IMG_2363.HEIC.observation: Looking almost straight down from a roof edge, north-north-west: a narrow square-tiled terracotta lane between white walls with a planted strip, private patios behind low walls with brown doors, and an arched white garden gateway with bougainvillea that opens onto crazy paving and the north pool lawn (bollard lights, palm, tree). Shows how the Elena north lane meets the north pool courtyard.

6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.title: Beach: pebbles on sand at the water line
6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.observation: Wide 16:9 image of the beach at the water line: coarse grey-brown sand with scattered dark rounded pebbles, a denser pebble band along the shore, small breaking waves and a kite-surfer far out. No location data in the file, so it is unplaced; which stretch of beach it shows is not confirmed.

IMG_2345.HEIC.title: Pintor Picasso: service road, utility sheds and bins
IMG_2345.HEIC.observation: Looking north-west up the asphalt service road off Calle Pintor Picasso. Left: a dark slatted fence, then low white utility sheds with brown doors and a meter box, then a long plain white boundary wall. Right: a low white building on a rough stone plinth with black tubular railings and a short concrete ramp, green and grey recycling bins, and large plane trees. Palms and the mountains beyond.

IMG_2364.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: barrel-tile lean-to over a magnolia bed
IMG_2364.HEIC.observation: From a roof edge looking south-east: a mono-pitch roof of lichen-mottled barrel tiles drops beside a tall dense magnolia-like shrub. Beyond: a two-storey white front with arched shuttered windows, a small barrel-tile canopy over a balcony and magenta bougainvillea.

IMG_2365.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down on the Elena north lane and its planted bed
IMG_2365.HEIC.observation: Almost straight down onto Calle Elena north, looking south-south-east: a straight square-tiled terracotta lane about 1.5 m wide with a narrow white edging kerb. On its left a raised planting bed of tall magnolia-like shrubs edged with strap-leaved plants, ending in a small bed boxed by a clipped hedge. On its right white house walls, a white sill/bench and a first-floor balcony with an iron rail. The lane turns right at the far end by bougainvillea.

IMG_2332.HEIC.title: Middle pool west side: path between the deck and a raised planter wall
IMG_2332.HEIC.observation: Looking north-north-west along the middle pool. A grey-brown crazy-paving path with a drain cover runs between the cream pool deck (behind the glass fence) and a raised white planter wall about 0.8 m high topped by a dense hedge with red flowers. Beyond: a lawn inside the glass fence, a white garden wall with a brown arched-top door, a small pergola entrance, clipped hedges and two-storey white houses with bougainvillea. GPS ±14 m, so the pin alone does not fix which lobe.

IMG_2339.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: walled lawn corner with espaliered bougainvillea
IMG_2339.HEIC.observation: A small lawn in the corner of two white garden walls, with bougainvillea trained flat along both walls, a green bollard light and a clipped shrub at the front. Square terracotta tiles with a grey border run along the near edge. Useful for wall planting and the bollard light.

IMG_2340.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: east gateway into the middle pool courtyard
IMG_2340.HEIC.observation: A white gateway with square piers and a gently curved coping over a flat head, an open black iron gate, and a terracotta path with a drain leading through to the middle pool (glass fence, bird-of-paradise, hedges). A Comunidad Villacana notice and two blue dog-rule signs are on the right pier; white walls with planting run either side. Matches the gate seen from inside in IMG_2244.

IMG_2350.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east: stamped walk, sandstone retaining wall
IMG_2350.HEIC.observation: The seafront promenade: pink-red stamped concrete about 3 m wide with a timber edge onto a strip of sandy, stony beach. On the landward side a yellow sandstone retaining wall about 1.2 m high carries a green mesh fence, with the white seafront houses (round tower with a tiled roof, balconies) standing above it. Slim white lamp posts, palms, the Barraka restaurant and the mountains in the distance. Shows the resort ground standing above the paseo here.

IMG_2327.HEIC.title: Cervantes at Elena: steps up to a door beside the lane
IMG_2327.HEIC.observation: Looking west up Cervantes from the Elena junction. On the right two red-tread steps with white sides climb to a brown timber door between a plumbago hedge and bougainvillea; the lane beyond shows the ramp strip and the steps beside it, a drain across the foot and service covers in the tiles.

IMG_2328.HEIC.title: Cervantes at Elena: ramp and steps side by side, drain at the foot
IMG_2328.HEIC.observation: Looking west-south-west up Cervantes: the smooth ramp strip on the left, the white-edged steps on the right, one drain grate right across the lane at the foot, white kerbs and clipped hedges both sides, a door step on the far right. Confirms the split ramp/steps built from IMG_2286.

IMG_2329.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn with a pollarded tree and white kerb
IMG_2329.HEIC.observation: Looking south-south-west across the junction: a small lawn edged by a low rounded white kerb, a pollarded tree with a round head, a manhole cover in the grass, terracotta paving round it, and two-storey houses with bougainvillea and balconies behind.

IMG_2330.HEIC.title: Calle Elena south from the junction, towards the middle pool
IMG_2330.HEIC.observation: Looking south along Elena south: a straight square-tiled lane between a hedge and planting on the left and a lawn on the right, white low kerb, pollarded trees, a palm and white terraces at the far end.

IMG_2331.HEIC.title: Middle pool north: crazy-paving path opening onto the lawn and pool
IMG_2331.HEIC.observation: Crazy-paving path between a hedge and a white wall, widening into a lawn wedge, with the pool and its glass fence beyond; a black iron gate at the right edge. GPS ±17 m, so the pin is only a rough guide.

IMG_2333.HEIC.title: Middle pool south-west: stone steps up a tiled path to a gate
IMG_2333.HEIC.observation: A terracotta-tiled path with three rough stone steps climbing between a tall hedge and a raised white wall, to a white gateway with bougainvillea at the top. A change of level leaving the middle pool courtyard.

IMG_2334.HEIC.title: Middle pool south: iron gate in a pergola frame onto a lane
IMG_2334.HEIC.observation: Looking south through a black iron double gate under a curved metal pergola frame: crazy paving with a drain grate, a raised white planter with shrubs on the right with a white step, a tiled lane beyond between white walls and planting.

IMG_2335.HEIC.title: Middle pool south: raised white planter with a blue tile panel
IMG_2335.HEIC.observation: Close view of a raised white rendered planter and wall with a framed panel of blue-and-white tiles, a seat-height wall bench recessed into it with a low plinth in front, and climbers above. Detail for the courtyard walls.

IMG_2336.HEIC.title: Calle Eva east of the middle pool: tiled path between lawns
IMG_2336.HEIC.observation: Looking north-east along a square-tiled path between two lawns, with round-headed trees, black lamp posts, low hedges and white terraces beyond.

IMG_2337.HEIC.title: Calle Eva east of the middle pool: lawn, round trees, lamp
IMG_2337.HEIC.observation: Similar view looking north-north-east: a lawn with a round-headed tree, bougainvillea on a white garden wall with brown doors, a black lamp post and the tiled path at the right edge.

IMG_2338.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: brown door, yellow-flowered shrub, lawn
IMG_2338.HEIC.observation: A brown timber door with a house-number plaque, a yellow-flowered shrub (St John's wort-like) beside it, a lawn and a pink-tiled path edge.

IMG_2341.HEIC.title: Curved low white wall with hedge, crazy paving and trees
IMG_2341.HEIC.observation: A curving low white wall topped by a clipped hedge beside crazy paving, with trees, garden tables and white terraces behind. GPS ±47 m: the place is not established from the pin; probably the middle pool courtyard.

IMG_2342.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena junction: lawn corner with pollarded tree and drain
IMG_2342.HEIC.observation: The junction lawn from another angle: white rounded kerb, pollarded tree, manhole, terracotta paving with a drain grate in the foreground, bougainvillea on the houses. GPS ±14 m.

IMG_2346.HEIC.title: Barraka Beach sign, thatched parasols and boardwalk
IMG_2346.HEIC.observation: On Barraka Beach: white planted BARRAKA BEACH sign, sand-filled barbecue boat on the left of the timber boardwalk looking seaward, thatched parasols and loungers. The boat is distinct from the planted sign.

IMG_2347.HEIC.title: Barraka Beach sign and boardwalk to the beach
IMG_2347.HEIC.observation: On Barraka Beach: white planted BARRAKA BEACH sign, sand-filled barbecue boat on the left of the timber boardwalk looking seaward, thatched parasols and loungers. The boat is distinct from the planted sign.

IMG_2349.HEIC.title: From the paseo: sandstone retaining wall and fence below the south pool
IMG_2349.HEIC.observation: Looking north-north-west from the paseo at the yellow sandstone retaining wall with a green mesh fence on top and a clipped hedge behind; the south pool area (pool, glass fence, white terraces) stands above it.

IMG_2351.HEIC.title: Paseo looking south: stamped walk, timber edge, beach and sea
IMG_2351.HEIC.observation: Looking south from the paseo over its pink stamped concrete and timber edge to the sandy, stony beach and the sea, a kite-surfer offshore.

IMG_2352.HEIC.title: Paseo looking west: sandstone wall, mesh fence, lamp posts
IMG_2352.HEIC.observation: Looking west-south-west along the paseo: the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the right, slim white lamp posts, palms, beach scrub on the left.

IMG_2354.HEIC.title: Paseo curving north-east beside the sandstone wall
IMG_2354.HEIC.observation: The paseo curving north-east with the sandstone retaining wall and green mesh fence on the left, a service cover in the stamped surface, the timber edge on the right.

IMG_2355.HEIC.title: Cervantes/Elena steps from the junction
IMG_2355.HEIC.observation: Close view of the three steps beside the ramp: white riser faces, terracotta treads with grey edges, the white wall and hedge on the right, the drain grate across the foot. Confirms the step arrangement built from IMG_2286.

IMG_2356.HEIC.title: Cervantes east of Elena: lane beside a plumbago hedge
IMG_2356.HEIC.observation: Looking north-east along Cervantes east of the Elena junction: a square-tiled lane with a low white kerb wall, a tall plumbago and shrub hedge on the left, patches of sun through trees.

IMG_2358.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down on Elena south and the junction lawns
IMG_2358.HEIC.observation: From a roof terrace looking south-south-east: the Elena south lane, small lawns with round clipped shrubs, private patios with walls, a brown door and a lamp post. Overhead layout of the junction's south side.

IMG_2359.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: over barrel tiles to the Cervantes patios
IMG_2359.HEIC.observation: From the roof looking south-west over a barrel-tile roof: white walls, private patios with bougainvillea and shrubs, a parasol, and the lawns along Cervantes.

IMG_2366.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios east of the Elena beds
IMG_2366.HEIC.observation: Looking down east-north-east from a roof: private patios behind white walls with bougainvillea, a timber pergola, outdoor furniture, and the tops of the magnolia shrubs. The east-side patios beyond the Elena beds.

IMG_2367.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking south over the Cervantes/Elena junction
IMG_2367.HEIC.observation: From the roof looking south: the junction lawns with round shrubs and the Elena south lane, patio walls with bougainvillea and parasols in the foreground.

IMG_2368.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west, along Cervantes
IMG_2368.HEIC.observation: Looking south-west from the roof over walled patios with trees, parasols and bougainvillea to the two-storey terraces along Cervantes and the tall trees on Dalí.

IMG_2369.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: patios and terraces south-west (second shot)
IMG_2369.HEIC.observation: Same view as IMG_2368, slightly to the left.

IMG_2481.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east towards Barraka: curving pink walk, sandstone wall, dry verge
IMG_2481.HEIC.observation: From the paseo's west stretch (52 mm lens): pink stamped walk curving between the sandstone retaining wall with green mesh fence and slim white lamps on the left, and a broad dry earth verge with a timber edge on the right. Barraka beach restaurant, its white pergola and thatched parasols ahead; La Concha behind. Phone GPS +/-2 m.

IMG_2482.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east: agave verge and Barraka restaurant
IMG_2482.HEIC.observation: Pink stamped walk with its timber edge, a row of young agaves planted along the verge, sandstone wall and fence on the left with slim white lamps at its foot; Barraka (two-storey white building with maroon awnings), white timber pergola and parasols at the far end. 52 mm lens.

IMG_2483.HEIC.title: Paseo looking north-east, second shot: agave verge to Barraka
IMG_2483.HEIC.observation: Same view as IMG_2482 turned a little right: agave row along the timber edge, open dry verge, Barraka restaurant, pergola, palms and parasols. 52 mm lens.

IMG_2488.HEIC.title: Calle Guillermo from its seaward end, looking up the lane
IMG_2488.HEIC.observation: Square terracotta-tiled lane between a whitewashed house wall (left, wide base plinth, meter box) and a raised white planter with strelitzia and lantana (right). A slot drain crosses the lane about 4 m ahead; lawns, a green lantern post and white garden walls beyond, a blue awning on a curved-topped wall at the far right. No steps visible. Phone GPS +/-4.7 m.

IMG_2494.HEIC.title: Narrow lane by Teodoro Rojo: barred windows, planter, drains
IMG_2494.HEIC.observation: Narrow square-tiled lane between white houses: green iron window grilles, a raised white planter and a trained bougainvillea trunk on the left, an arched window recess on the right, several slot and square drain covers; bougainvillea and a tiled-roof house at the far end. Very close to IMG_2241.

IMG_2507.HEIC.title: Elena 25 passage: street arch with potted schefflera
IMG_2507.HEIC.observation: Arched opening in a white wall off Calle Elena south: plain square lane tiles with a grey margin outside, then a covered entry floored with diagonal terracotta tiles and small blue-and-white inset tiles, flush with the lane (no step). A potted schefflera inside; the entry turns right to a door. Part of the CALLE ELENA 25 passage in IMG_2508.

IMG_2508.HEIC.title: Covered passage signed CALLE ELENA 25, looking through to a garden gate
IMG_2508.HEIC.observation: Covered walk-through with a flat white ceiling and hanging lantern, brown panelled double doors on both sides, tile plaque CALLE ELENA 25, potted scheffleras and dracaena; an arch at the far end opens onto a red-tiled path and a white-framed iron garden gate under bougainvillea. Enters the registry block 6265601UF1366N_part1 east of Calle Elena south; not in data/passages.json.

IMG_2518.HEIC.title: Elena covered walkway east portal: CALLE ELENA 18 36 plaque, two steps and ramp
IMG_2518.HEIC.observation: Inside the Calle Elena covered walkway at its east end: tile plaque CALLE ELENA 18 36 (IMG_2254 shows the same plaque cropped as 18 3..), CASA WILKES and GEE name tiles beside dark brown panelled double doors, an AGUA POTABLE hatch. The passage floor is two steps (white-nosed terracotta treads) above the Calle Elena lane, with a red ribbed rubber ramp beside them.

IMG_2519.HEIC.title: Elena covered walkway looking west to the arch and the 36/34 gates
IMG_2519.HEIC.observation: From the top of the east steps: terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles, red ribbed ramp on the right, a pebble mat, brown doors on both sides, then the far arch with two large potted plants and the private gates beyond (as IMG_2202).

IMG_2539.HEIC.title: Elena north by the Cervantes junction: steps and tiled lane between planted beds
IMG_2539.HEIC.observation: Ground shot looking south-west along Calle Elena north towards the Cervantes junction: square terracotta tiles with a slot drain and two inspection covers, low white bed walls with clipped shrubs and plumbago, a short flight of tiled steps up on the left beside a lawn, brown door in a white gateway with bougainvillea on the right, a street-name tile on a garden wall ahead. GPS ±16 m.

IMG_2549.HEIC.title: Calle Eva: lane between a white wall and planted beds, towards the middle pool
IMG_2549.HEIC.observation: Looking west along Calle Eva: square terracotta tiles with grey margins, a white wall with plinth on the left (tile sign), a loquat tree and planted bed on the right with a green iron fence behind, a person walking, the open area beyond.

IMG_2559.HEIC.title: Calle Patricia from its west end, looking along the lane
IMG_2559.HEIC.observation: Long straight lane of square terracotta tiles with grey margins between white garden walls; trained bougainvillea on the left wall, hedges and a candelabra cactus over the right wall, a tall pine at the far end. Answers photo request patricia-west.

IMG_2572.HEIC.title: Path between oleanders off Calle Silvia south
IMG_2572.HEIC.observation: Narrow tiled path (square terracotta, grey margin) between oleander hedges, green windbreak cloth on a fence on the left, lawns, a clipped topiary tree and white houses beyond.

IMG_2586.HEIC.title: Courtyard with arch and patterned floor near Calle Jorge
IMG_2586.HEIC.observation: Small courtyard between white houses: terracotta floor with blue-and-white inset tiles, potted palms and plants, wall lantern, iron balcony and window grilles, an arched opening at the far end under a tiled roof.

IMG_2600.HEIC.title: From the foot of Calle Guillermo: tiled path down past the white wall towards the beach
IMG_2600.HEIC.observation: Tiled ramp path descending east-south-east from beside the kiosk: lavender and shrubs on the left, a white wall with green rigid mesh on top on the right; at the bottom grass, a hedge and a green rigid-mesh fence, with the beach, parasols and shrubs beyond. A tall white pier at the left edge may be the beach gateway. The fence ahead is green rigid mesh, not the white railings the model has from IMG_2226.

IMG_2616.HEIC.title: Barraka boardwalk and BARRAKA BEACH sign planter
IMG_2616.HEIC.observation: The weathered green plank boardwalk across the sand towards the parasols, the white BARRAKA BEACH planter on the left with a thatched shade and a boat planter, terracotta pots and a strelitzia on the right.

IMG_2629.HEIC.title: Beach east of Barraka from the paseo edge
IMG_2629.HEIC.observation: Sand with a few tufts beside the pink paseo and its timber edge, Barraka's beach bar, parasols and loungers, palms and the white Barraka building on the right.

IMG_2645.HEIC.title: South pool lawn and houses
IMG_2645.HEIC.observation: Broad lawn in front of white two-storey houses with tiled roofs, arched entrance and balconies; a low white curved bed wall, steps to a terrace, and the glass pool fence on the right.

IMG_2658.HEIC.title: Covered entrance off Calle Silvia south: three tiled steps beside a red ribbed ramp
IMG_2658.HEIC.observation: Looking into a covered entrance from the lane: three steps of terracotta tiles with dark border strips and white risers, and a red ribbed rubber ramp beside them on the left, rising to a floor of terracotta with blue-and-white insets.

IMG_2675.HEIC.title: Lane off Teodoro Rojo between planted walls
IMG_2675.HEIC.observation: Tiled lane with drains between white walls, bougainvillea and a gnarled tree, hedge over a white bed wall and lawn on the right, houses at the far end.

IMG_2687.HEIC.title: Elena north: lane beside a house with window grilles, towards the lawns
IMG_2687.HEIC.observation: Square-tiled lane along a white house with green iron window grilles and a lantern, a planted bed on the right, a white gateway with a barred window and the lawns beyond.

253A75E4-A471-4502-9F5D-C9BAF074D664.jpg.title: Beach with loungers, closed parasols and a plank walkway to the sea
253A75E4-A471-4502-9F5D-C9BAF074D664.jpg.observation: Beach with loungers, closed parasols and a plank walkway to the sea. No camera pin. Seen on the contact sheet; not compared with the model.

IMG_2442.HEIC.title: Lane of octagonal terracotta tiles past candelabra cacti, a white post box and steps up to a patio
IMG_2442.HEIC.observation: Lane of octagonal terracotta tiles past candelabra cacti, a white post box and steps up to a patio.
